استكملوا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْمَلُوا (istakmalū) /is.tak.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
# اُسْتُكْمِلُوا (ustukmilū) /us.tuk.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
# اِسْتَكْمِلُوا (istakmilū) /is.tak.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
